body:
>The Batch amendment comes with a couple of terrific features, like the ability to provide atomic swaps with multiple signers involved for different Inner transactions inside one Batch. I absolutely love the things we can do with that feature. And I've been deep in code playing with these features. I have spent a significant amount of time by now to understand how this works on a signing, hashing and encoding level. What was striking is the complete lack of examples, resulting in the need to do a lot of searching/trying/reverse engineering (test cases) to be able to use it. Which is OK, it's a new feature, on devnet, and it's fine to accept that tutorials, sample code, etc. stil have to be created and published. 


We should address the above feedback. The feature **is** available on Devnet, so we should be able to provide tutorials/examples to show developers how to use this.

- [X] Javascript - **Done**
- [x] Python - **Done**
- [x] Go - **Done**
title: Add Batch Transactions tutorial
